text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp season has come again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Umamusume, there's no season more
vital to
their training. At the same time
though, it's also a
time to relax.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, Trainer! Look at that group comin'
this
way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what's going on? Why is
everyone wearing
weird masks?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People walk by wearing various traditional
festival masks—from foxes to
tengu demons to
stylized human
hyottoko and okame masks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooohhh, that one's a kagura dance
mask.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Wearing masks and dancing
at
festivals has been a custom around
these parts
since ancient times!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure these people are practicing their
dances
to get ready for the summer
festival!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Dancing fools and watching fools. We're
all fools,
so let's dance. ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's all from me, Matikanefukukitaru,
scholar of
Japanese traditions!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh wow! Lucha libre! No, mascarada!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea people in this country hid
their
identities with masks and danced
too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, this is a challenge I can't overlook. I need to join this festival!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right—now's not the time for fear!
I must
dive right in!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I won't run away and hide! I'm all
on board
for a dance competition!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa seems really passionate
about this unexpected event. It's
shaping up to be a very
different
summer from last year.
